text:
jess: Cutting RC now for svc-search. Build search:2026.3.14-rc2. Need QA + sheriff signoff before promo in 30m. pin artifact=search:2026.3.14-rc2

deploy-bot: deploybot: created release candidate search:2026.3.14-rc2, id=rc-3782, queued to staging

riley: I'll run quick smoke and kv warm. @maya can you start the QA checklist?

maya: Starting QA run. Test plan link: https://redwood.internal/qa/plans/3782. Focusing on latency regressions and tokenization edgecases.

chris: Oncall here. Watchlist: increased 95p latency on embed endpoints last time. If >2x, abort.

arun: Dependency freeze enforced. No infra changes allowed during promo window. pin infra-submodule at d3f4c2

maya: Smoke done: basic queries ✅, kv warm success ✅, small correctness sample failure on emoji normalization (fails on U+1F9E0). Putting a blocker flag.

riley: Confirm repro steps? paste logs? if it's just normalization we might hotfix quickly. @jess should we hold promo?

maya: Repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/search -d '{"q":"brain 🧠"}'
```
Returned token mismatch > trace. Full log: https://logs.redwood/3782/emoji-fail

jess: We have 18 minutes before the promo window closes. Two options: (A) rollback to rc1 which is proven, or (B) quick patch and re-run QA (riskier). Thoughts?

chris: :warning: If we proceed with patch, set canary to 10% and auto-fallback to rc1 on error budget breach. I'll standby for rollback if needed.

riley: I can patch normalization in ~12m, build in 6m, smoke in 4m. That's tight but doable. Preference B with strict canary + rollback.

maya: If patch goes in, I need extra 6m to re-run edge-case suite. OK with canary route.

jess: Decision: apply hotfix to rc2, re-run QA. If mem or latency regressions >15% or errors >0.5%, auto-fallback to search:2026.3.14-rc1. Rolling out canary 10% for 20m then evaluate. Notifying docs + release notes owners to hold.

deploy-bot: deploybot: triggered canary rollout of search:2026.3.14-rc2 -> 10% across us-east-1, duration=20m. rollback_on=error_rate>0.5% OR latency_p95>1.15x

arun: Added traffic shim and KV warm cache prefill. Observability dashboards: https://obs.redwood/dash/search-rc2

maya: QA re-run in progress. Will post PASS/FAIL in 8m.

riley: Patch merged to rc2 branch. New build id=3782.2

maya: QA PASS. Emoji normalization fixed, edge suite green. No perf regression observed in our samples. Marking signoff.

jess: Thanks. @chris you have sheriff handoff for the next 40m. Promo scheduled at +30m to 100% if canary healthy. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-14-search-rc2.md

chris: Taking sheriff. I'll watch SLOs and escalate if needed. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary healthy at 10% for 20m. Promoting to 100% in 2m.

deploy-bot: deploybot: promotion complete. search:2026.3.14-rc2 now live at 100% in us-east-1. Announcing release in #product and updating release_notes.

jess: Closing thread. Postmortem will only be needed if rollback occurs. Great job team :tada:
